hints: Part-way through the trip, what do you actually need to know to finish it well?
Which cities have been visited, and which one you are standing in. The order you visited them in does not matter at all.
'Which cities' is a set of at most twelve things - which fits in the bits of a single integer.
So the table is indexed by (set visited, city standing in), and there are 2^n times n of those rather than (n-1)! orders.
